observed_visual_features: Three overlapping crown skirts: small pointed upper tier, medium middle tier, broad low tier.
Smooth pale cyan/icy-blue crown surfaces, strongest highlights on upper tier and darker blue undersides and lower layers.
Narrow triangular V incisions in the skirt edges produce repeated irregular angular lobes; do not replace with realistic needle branches.
Short exposed trunk; red-brown in B20 crop and very dark brown in B40 crop. This observed color change does not establish a second tree family.
Top point and skirt edge show slight asymmetry/curvature; shapes are clean and sculpted, with minimal surface texture.
Soft blue-gray cast/contact shadows on pale snow; no visible green foliage or high-frequency realistic bark/needle detail in selected crops.
Dense repetitions show apparent size, orientation and silhouette variation.

family_assessment.supported: One consistent three-tier stylized snow-conifer family across inspected samples, with variation in apparent width, height, tier outline and trunk shading.

camera_and_coverage.observed: Elevated oblique game view in the inspected sampled frames; no demonstrated orbit around one identified tree.
camera_and_coverage.instruction: Match the visible source view and preserve a coherent reconstruction around it; label unseen views as reconstructed rather than verified source geometry.
